title: The US Commerce Department says it began probing Megaspeed in 2024 over possible export rule violations; Nvidia put Megaspeed on its "no sell" list in June 2025 (Kanishka Singh/Reuters)
summary: Kanishka Singh / Reuters: The US Commerce Department says it began probing Megaspeed in 2024 over possible export rule violations; Nvidia put Megaspeed on its “no sell” list in June 2025 — The US Commerce Department and Justice Department released information on Monday about Washington's investigation …
